Pybind cannot convert a Python tuple to an int64_t scalar, resulting in the observed TypeError before the kernel ever runs. The fix is to make the interface accept the target shape without requiring a tuple: modify expand_mask to accept either an int64 scalar (ignored, because mask already has the target shape) or, more robustly, change the binding to accept a list/tuple of ints representing the target shape.
